title: AgentReviewVerdict
description: Standardized schema for Tier 1 and Tier 2 agentic review verdicts across repositories.

evaluated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the review was conducted.

reviewer.description: Identifier or role of the reviewing subagent.

review_depth.description: Depth of review performed. Automatically elevated to 'architectural' when objective escalation triggers fire.

escalation_triggers.description: Objective auto-escalation triggers that elevated the review to architectural depth.

deterministic_checks.description: Status results of deterministic compilation and test checks.

architectural_checks.description: Mandatory trace attestations required when review_depth is 'architectural'.

import_boot_isolation.description: Top-level imports traced for eager initialization, DB pool creation, env validation, or server-only leaks into client/edge/CLI contexts.

fail_closed_defaults.description: Missing env vars, empty/omitted parameters, and non-default runtime modes verified to fail closed with actionable errors.

write_atomicity.description: Multi-statement persistence flows verified to use atomic transactions and clean partial-failure handling.

no_test_theater.description: Unit tests verified to exercise runtime execution rather than static source-file regex matching.

spec_boundary_alignment.description: Optional attestation that task spec instructions were validated against repository ADRs and runtime/trust boundaries.

blocking_count.description: Total count of blocking defects (sum of P0 + P1 findings).

summary.description: Executive review summary articulating reasons for the verdict.

findings.description: List of discrete findings categorized by severity.

file.description: Relative file path containing the finding.

line_start.description: Starting line number in the diff/file.

line_end.description: Ending line number in the diff/file.

criterion_id.description: Associated acceptance criterion ID or rule tag.

evidence.description: Proof of defect: reproduction trace, input trigger, or violated constraint.

suggested_fix.description: Actionable code diff or remediation instruction.
